problem: The correction for the date basis landed for the grades but was applied too widely. evidence_of_results says of the improved information and of the sampled services being absent that 'those findings run to the end of 2024, when the portal was under construction'. The source (page 7) makes both statements 'at the moment of writing the report', after the first services of 22 April 2025, about services then available. transferable also says 'seven sampled services before the first services', and the lesson says 'a period largely before the first services'. This contradicts the success reason on INT-MNE-0022>MNE-CSO-2025-001-0019 ('at the time of writing') and item 0029, and it misdates the one positive finding to when the portal did not function.
suggested_fix: Separate the two: the service delivery grades reflect findings to the end of 2024, when the portal was under construction; the statements that information improved and that none of the sampled services was on the portal are notes made at the time of writing, after the first services. Reword transferable and the lesson to say the grades, not the absence of the sampled services, largely predate the first services.
